correctness.rationale: The Paley–Wiener logarithmic unitary yields a closed generator -d/dx+b on H^1 with limits -1/2 and n-1/2. The reciprocal integrating factor is L2 exactly inside the strip, gives a one-dimensional adjoint eigenfunction, and the explicit half-line Volterra formula establishes closed codimension-one range and index -1. Weyl cutoff sequences locate generator boundary essential spectrum; exact semigroup norms and Laplace integrals give the outer resolvent formula. Time sampling aliases infinitely many adjoint generator eigenvectors at every interior annulus point; power radii and Weyl cutoff sequences give the exact fixed-time essential annulus. The finite checker tests formulas but is not the infinite-dimensional proof.
